headlines.summary: On October 1, the SENSEX tumbled by 570.59 points or 0.79% to close at 71,909.70. Meanwhile, the NIFTY50 fell by 198.50 points or 0.88% to end at 22,421.95.

headlines.headline: NIFTY FMCG index hits fresh 52-week low; Here is why FMCG shares are falling
headlines.summary: Shares in FMCG space such as ITC, Hindustan Unilever, Godrej Consumer Products, Dabur and Tata Consumer Products are trading close to their respective 52-week lows.

headlines.headline: IT stocks shine: Infosys, TCS, Tech Mahindra, others lift Nifty IT up 1.7%; what investors should know
headlines.summary: IT stocks gained after the opening bell on October 1, as investors focused on the US inflation cues ahead of Accenture earnings and a few corporate actions in the domestic market.

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 edge higher led by gains in ICICI Bank, Reliance Industries
headlines.summary: The SENSEX rose as much as 212 points led by gains in the index heavyweights like ICICI Bank, Reliance Industries, TCS, L&T, Kotak Mahindra Bank and SBI

headlines.summary: The 30-share BSE SENSEX fell 242.65 points, or 0.33%, to settle at 72,529.07, after slumping 707.72 points, or 0.97%, to hit an intraday low of 72,064.

headlines.headline: SENSEX, NIFTY50 decline for second straight session dragged by Reliance, ICICI Bank
headlines.summary: The benchmarks recovered most of their losses in late noon deals on account of value buying in index heavyweights like Adani Ports, Sun Pharma, Tata Steel Kotak Mahindra Bank and NTPC.

headlines.headline: Bharti Airtel, Vodafone Idea, MTNL: How did telecom stocks perform on Sept 29 after TRAI's data release?
headlines.summary: Telecom stocks were in the focus of investors on September 29, as investors reacted to the August 2026 subscription data release by the regulator TRAI for the domestic market.

headlines.summary: Both stocks had rallied earlier on expectations of a possible Tata Sons listing, making the latest proposal significant for investors tracking the value of Tata Sons' investments.
